name: Iowa

flag.description: Three vertical stripes of blue, white and red; on the wider white centre, a bald eagle carries a blue streamer reading OUR LIBERTIES WE PRIZE AND OUR RIGHTS WE WILL MAINTAIN, above IOWA in red.
flag.symbolism: The colours echo the French tricolour, recalling that Iowa was part of the Louisiana Purchase from France.

hook: Iowa is the French tricolour with a bald eagle and the word IOWA dropped onto the white stripe.
trivia: It was designed by Dixie Cornell Gebhardt of the Daughters of the American Revolution during the First World War.
Iowa troops had no state flag to carry in the war; the design was approved in 1917 and officially adopted in 1921.
